- Work platform, scaffolding, and/or ladders. Installation height: max. 3.50 m above floor.

- Fixed price for the refrigeration connection of indoor air conditioning units in connection with
the technical handover of equipment by REMKO (also for A2L refrigerants in accordance with
DIN EN 60335-2).
- The contractor must announce all necessary power requirements for CTS pre-installation.

3. Pipe network:
Refrigerant pipes made of seamless drawn copper from Cu-DHP, strength R220 soft according to
EN 12735-1, cleaned inside, pipe ends sealed, with factory-fitted thermal insulation made of
modified polyethylene according to DIN EN 14313 with structured white protective film. Building
material class flame retardant CL s1 d0 according to DIN EN 13501-1, does not drip when burning,
minimal smoke development. Permissible operating pressure 169 bar with 3-fold safety up to 100 °C
according to EN 14276.
Installation of pipes in accordance with DIN EN 378-2 and DKI i.164, copper pipes in refrigeration
and air conditioning technology. Brazing using silver or phosphorus solders in a protective gas
atmosphere. Pressing with special press fittings for refrigerant-carrying pipes in accordance with
DIN EN ISO 14903.

Brazing is carried out using brazing alloys in accordance with DIN EN ISO 17672, recommended
brazing alloys CuP 179 or CuP 279, if necessary, fluxes in accordance with DIN EN 1045 type
FH10 must be used. For solders AG 134, AG 145, and AG 244, use flux in accordance with DIN
EN 1045. Type: FH 10. Brazed joints may only be made by qualified personnel. Before and during
the joining process by brazing or welding, the pipes must be flushed with dry protective gases, e.g.,
inert gases (noble gases, nitrogen, and mixtures thereof) or forming gases (e.g., nitrogen-hydrogen,
nitrogen-argon, etc., max. hydrogen content 4 vol.%). When using capillary solder and press fittings,
consult the respective fitting manufacturer regarding the possible areas of application, particularly
the maximum permissible operating pressures.

The installation of the distribution sets involves connecting and soldering the refrigerant lines
already connected by the installer to the distributors. Since absolute cleanliness must be ensured
in this complex pipe system, soldering is carried out under dry nitrogen.

4. Miscellaneous / Additional services, special services:
- The pipe dimensions must be checked by the contractor and adjusted if necessary.
- The contractor must adjust the system components so that the planned functions and
performance are achieved and the legal requirements are met. The air volume flows must be
adjusted in accordance with the calculated settings. Measured values must be documented.
- The contractor shall provide one-time training for the operating and maintenance personnel for
the system. Leading time for coordination: 2 weeks.
- If necessary, the delivery and installation of special fastening structures, e.g., brackets and
support frames is also part of this contract.
- Delivery of the operating materials and media required for commissioning and trial operation,
particularly the required refrigerant R 410A.

5. As-built documentation
As-built documentation, digital revision documents in German and English language including:
- System diagrams.
- General electrical diagrams and connection diagrams in accordance with DIN EN 61082-1

“Electrotechnical documentation ”
- Compilation of the key technical data.
- Copies of the required test and manufacturer certificates.
- All operating and maintenance documents, required for safe and economical operation.
- Protocol on the training of maintenance and operating personnel.
